run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum Hamming distance for all rotations of an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in main
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes max Hamming distance by comparing each rotation to the original array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use array slicing instead of manual concatenation for rotation comparison
review_f_gold: review f_gold for edge cases like single element arrays and arrays with all identical elements
